$comment: The Almanac (design doc §7): the permanent tree bought with Verdure, surviving every Migration. Verdure is never spent away — nodes ALLOCATE from the banked total (available = verdurePoints - sum of owned node costs) so the +2%/pt passive keeps counting the full total. All costs and effect sizes are first guesses tuned to ~10 Verdure from the first Migration; the exotic §7 nodes (starting tool tiers, auto-craft, starting-zone skips) wait for their systems. requires = single prerequisite node. repeatable = the line is bought over and over, level L costing costVerdure · costGrowth.almanac^L, its effects scaled by the levels held; every other node is a one-off.

nodes.name: The Long Song
nodes.$note: The endless line — the Almanac's only repeatable node, and the reason Verdure never dead-ends. The rest of the tree totals 99 points, which a steady warden passes around the third fold; after that the currency kept arriving with nothing to spend it on, which is what made a late fold feel like it had nothing in it. Level L costs costVerdure · costGrowth.almanac^L forever. It grants the SAME additive value to gathering and to carrying on purpose: yieldBonus and carrierCapacityBonus are both summed bands (yield is mult·(1+bonus), haul is haulMult·(1+carrierBonus)), so every level moves the two by the same proportion and the gather-vs-haul ratio cannot drift. Granting the gathering half alone would re-open the full-basket jam that the self-haul floor was built to catch.
